ruleDefinitions.name: Disk Image Mounting Via Hdiutil - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the hdiutil utility in order to mount disk images.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/hdiutil$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*attach\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mount\\ .*")))
